section.title: AutoYaST compatibility reference
section.para: Let’s describe which sections and elements from an AutoYaST profile are (or will be) supported in Agama. In some cases, you might find a table with the following columns:

listitem.para: AutoYaST: name of the AutoYaST element.
Supported: whether it is (or will be) supported. The meaning of each value is:
Planned: not supported yet, but there are plans to support it.
Undecided: no decision about whether it should be supported.
No: there are no plans for supporting that element.
Agama: name of the Agama element.
Comment: any comment or reason about the element.

row.entry: Creating directories by using trailing slash is not yet supported.
In agama it is split to files.user and files.group

section.para: This section is supported. It corresponds to Agama connections, but the format is not exactly the same.
